sub_graphs.description: Models the bitmask-based historical data availability signaling

nodes.label: Block Bitmask Uninitialized
nodes.description: Node has not yet configured its block availability bitmask

nodes.label: Set Block Bitmask
nodes.description: Configure 10-bit bitmask representing historical data spans the node will retain

nodes.label: Bitmask Configured
nodes.description: Node has configured its availability commitment for 10% of chain history

nodes.label: New Block Received
nodes.description: A new block has been added to the chain

nodes.label: Check Block Span Match
nodes.description: Determine if new block falls within node's bitmask commitment

nodes.label: Retain Block Bodies and Receipts
nodes.description: Store block bodies and receipts for blocks matching bitmask spans

nodes.label: Historical Data Retained
nodes.description: Block data stored according to bitmask commitment

nodes.label: Historical Data Pruned
nodes.description: Block data not retained as it falls outside bitmask spans

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7801: Historical Data Retrieval Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response flow for retrieving historical block data from peers

nodes.label: Historical Data Needed
nodes.description: Node needs historical block bodies or receipts it doesn't have locally

nodes.label: Identify Peers with Data
nodes.description: Find peers whose bitmask indicates they have the requested data span

nodes.label: Candidate Peers Identified
nodes.description: One or more peers advertise availability for requested data

nodes.label: Send GetBlockBodies Request
nodes.description: Request block bodies from peer using eth/69 format

nodes.label: Send GetReceipts Request
nodes.description: Request receipts from peer using eth/69 format

nodes.label: Awaiting Peer Response
nodes.description: Request sent, waiting for peer to respond

nodes.label: Receive BlockBodies Response
nodes.description: Process incoming block bodies from peer

nodes.label: Receive Receipts Response
nodes.description: Process incoming receipts from peer

nodes.label: Historical Data Received
nodes.description: Requested data successfully retrieved from peer

nodes.label: Data Unavailable
nodes.description: No peer could provide the requested historical data

external_entities.description: Higher-level application requesting historical blockchain data

ambiguities.text: Nodes MAY set at least one bit in the blockBitmask to on upon startup
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes are expected but not required to participate in data availability. Nodes with all-zero bitmask contribute no historical data but may still consume.

ambiguities.text: No explicit error message definitions provided for protocol failures
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume protocol failures result in connection termination without specific error codes. Implementations should handle peer disconnection gracefully.

ambiguities.text: ENR encoding method lacks the authentication and reliability of the handshake approach
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume ENR-based discovery should be considered untrusted and always verified through handshake before relying on advertised availability.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes honestly advertise their data availability via bitmask and actually retain the advertised data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious nodes could advertise false availability, causing retrieval failures and network-wide data availability degradation

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient network participation ensures historical data remains retrievable with high probability
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Low adoption could result in historical data becoming irretrievable, breaking applications depending on historical state

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes maintain their bitmask commitment consistently over time without silently dropping data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data availability guarantees degrade over time as nodes drop data without updating their advertised bitmask

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control enough of the network to make specific historical spans unavailable
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted data unavailability attacks could censor specific historical transactions or blocks
